# Bundled fonts

Both fonts are shipped in `app/src/main/res/font/` as variable fonts from the
[google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) repository and are licensed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (full texts in this folder).

| File | Font | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `space_grotesk.ttf` | Space Grotesk (variable `wght`) | `ofl/spacegrotesk/SpaceGrotesk[wght].ttf` | `OFL-SpaceGrotesk.txt` |
| `inter.ttf` | Inter (variable `opsz`, `wght`) | `ofl/inter/Inter[opsz,wght].ttf` | `OFL-Inter.txt` |
